system.description:
• The continent-wide network originating from Opal, working closely with Opal's government. Many worship Mask.
  • Robins are the Guild's main force — versatile, reliable, and trusted with most day-to-day jobs.
  • The Guild deals in theft and information as much as assassination; at the Robin level, the work is mostly the former.
  • Guild Contract: On a Guild-assigned contract, you may try a lock you failed once more, and a failed Pick Pocket is noticed only if you fail by 5 or more. When your Sneak Attack hits, the next ally to attack that target before your next turn has Advantage.
  • Guild Signal: Advantage on checks gathering information for a Crow or Raven superior, and on checks identifying other Guild members by their signals and methods.
